root_cause: The existing canonical social publisher records exact LINKEDIN_REAUTH_REQUIRED and provider_auth_preflight=failed inside content_publication_obligations.evidence when LinkedIn personal has APPROVED draft without provider ID, but portal readback selected only last_error. The empty last_error made the portal show an unspecific provider/source recovery code.
prevention: Use canonical-tenant admin readback and select only scalar evidence->>provider_auth_preflight and evidence->>error; never expose raw error, secret OAuth link, provider ID or account ID. A real external_id always triggers no-repost path before any auth diagnostic. Missing external_id and approved content must never mean provider-side publication or legitimate bypass of user OAuth consent.

evidence.source: Supabase original content publication obligation and canonical setup, 2026-10-29
